description: This file defines the EntityTypeManagerInterface, an interface for managing entity types in Drupal, including methods for retrieving handlers, storage, view builders, route providers, and definitions.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface
classes.description: Interface for entity type managers, providing methods to access handlers, storage, view builders, route providers, and definitions for entity types.

methods.name: getAccessControlHandler
methods.description: Creates a new access control handler instance for a given entity type.

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Creates a new storage instance for a given entity type.

methods.name: getViewBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new view builder instance for a given entity type.

methods.name: getListBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new entity list builder for a given entity type.

methods.name: getFormObject
methods.description: Creates a new form instance for a given entity type and operation.

methods.name: getRouteProviders
methods.description: Gets all route provider instances for a given entity type.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks whether a certain entity type has a specific handler.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns a handler instance for a given entity type and handler type.

methods.name: createHandlerInstance
methods.description: Creates a new handler instance given a class and optional entity type definition.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the plugin definition for a given entity type, or NULL if invalid.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Returns all plugin definitions for entity types.
